$schema-note: Consumed by scripts/audit-advisories.mjs. Each entry excuses one advisory identifier at or above minimumSeverity, and only for dependencies absent from the production tree. An advisory reachable from production always fails, allowlisted or not, and an entry past its reviewBy date always fails.

allowed.justification: No patched braces release is listed as of 2026-10-07. The affected deeply nested glob patterns reach braces through lint/build configuration and repository source/import expressions, not uploaded molecular data; braces and its callers are absent from the production dependency tree. Malicious pull-request source or configuration could still exhaust a CI/build process, so this exception accepts that bounded availability risk, not a claim that the vulnerability is fixed or unreachable. Existing CI timeouts and read-only workflow permissions bound that risk. Production reachability must continue to fail this gate.
allowed.resolution: Recheck upstream and replace or patch the affected development dependency before reviewBy; do not extend automatically. The original historical dependency lock is preserved separately for scientific-record replay.
